name: mcp-agent
summary: Python framework for composing MCP-connected agents and workflows, with connection lifecycle management and optional Temporal-backed durable execution.
description: Install with pip install mcp-agent (PyPI 0.2.6, Python 3.10+). MCPApp configures agents and server connections; workflow patterns include routers, parallel/map-reduce, orchestrator and evaluator-optimizer. Expose applications as MCP servers, or switch execution_engine to temporal for pause/resume, retries and durable history. Model credentials and connected-server permissions are configured separately; this entry covers the Apache-2.0 SDK, not managed cloud service pricing.

agent_access.notes: Public source repository; local library. Model services and compute have separate requirements and costs.
